name: omareader
description: Restyle Chromium pages with the active Omarchy theme.

scripts.lint: eslint . && (command -v ruff >/dev/null && ruff check host scripts/test-host.py || echo 'ruff not installed; skipped')
scripts.test: python3 scripts/test-host.py && node scripts/test-site-fixes.mjs && node scripts/test-background.mjs && node scripts/test-contrast.mjs && node scripts/test-theme-fetch.mjs && node scripts/test-update-notice.mjs && bash scripts/test-install.sh
